name: claude-persistent-memory
description: Continuity-of-self memory for persistent-identity Claude Code agents. Ships a bundled `local-vault` CLI backing the Memory.* contract so the plugin works standalone on any project from day one (no AgentSmith / no svc / no api dependency). Auto-detects an `agentsmith-api` backend when present (AgentSmith mode); otherwise routes Memory.* to the bundled CLI (standalone mode). Phase-1a MVP: local-vault CLI + plugin scaffolding + standalone-mode `state` Memory.Store target recognized. Phase-1b will add the dreaming-model hooks (recall, consolidate-and-restart, context-pressure).
